summary: ORA iteration 2 (Decision Engine) fully validated. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_ora_decision_engine.py — root, register+seed 7, /auth/me with/without token, wrong password 401, memory add+ask, /api/decisions returns 7 rich seeds with all required keys (id,title,description,origin,category,urgency,importance,risk,economic_impact,personal_impact,time_required_min,energy,place,people,starts_at,deadline,status,linked_to,metadata,history,created_at,score,reason,reason_tags), /decisions/top?limit=3 sorted desc with Italian reasons ending in '.', top-1 is 'Esci tra 25 minuti' with tag 'imminent', 'Prepara la valigia' in top-3 with linked_soon/deadline_24h/trip_prep tags, 'Hai risparmiato 220 €' insight excluded from top3 and tagged 'insight', POST /decisions creates dec_* with status open and 'created' history event, adding an exam within 24h dampens Palestra (tag dampened_by_stakes, score decreases), /decisions/{id}/resolve returns non-empty Italian solution (real gpt-5.2 call) and adds ai_resolution_proposed history event, complete+dismiss remove item from /top, invalid JWT → 401 on GET+POST, legacy /priorities default max 3 (each with reason), /priorities?limit=10 works, legacy POST /tasks with kind:'bill' maps to category:'bill' and appears in /decisions, /tasks/{id}/dismiss+complete+resolve delegate correctly, demo@ora.app user has decisions with origin 'migration:task' proving legacy migration ran. Frontend (mobile 390x844 Expo web): login demo@ora.app→Home, brand 'ORA' visible, EXACTLY 3 cards (priority-card-0/1/2 present, priority-card-3 absent), every visible card has non-empty priority-reason-N (e.g. 'Scade tra 3 giorni · Rimandarla ha conseguenze economiche · Richiede pochi minuti.'), home-show-more-button visible, tapping it loads priority-card-3, priority-resolve-0 opens resolve-modal and shows Italian AI solution within ~10s, resolve-done-button closes modal, /profilo route works and profile-logout-button returns to /login. No page errors, no red screen. One cosmetic warning persists: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (already reported in iteration 1).
